title: Explicit foreign-entity declarations that cannot both fit the same facts
initial_observation: IF a dated LD-1 explicitly reports no qualifying foreign entity for a legal client, while a contemporaneous FARA Exhibit A identifies ownership/control of that same client that appears to meet the applicable LD-1 criteria.
expected_observation: THEN establish the exact legal entities, registration scope, activity, ownership/control facts and filing-date rules, and compare amendments before calling the declarations inconsistent.
possible_finding_and_basis: Inconsistent public descriptions of who directs a policy campaign can be consequential. FARA registration alone neither triggers every LDA field nor proves a false declaration.
operational_join: LDA registrant/client IDs and FARA registration/principal IDs are distinct. Bridge exact legal client and disclosed control relationship with dated original documents.
temporal_geographic_scope: US disclosures, same legal client and relevant dates/activity. Apply filing-date thresholds; an old semiannual instructions PDF is not current quarterly guidance.
ordinary_explanations_and_falsifiers: Foreign principal is not the qualifying controlling entity
Threshold or report scope not met
mandatory_evidence: Actual Exhibit A and referenced ownership evidence
Applicable current or historic LDA criteria
next_cheapest_check: Read the exact yes/no declaration and applicable rule before joining names; confirm the client is the same entity described in Exhibit A.
novelty_vs_baseline: I01 adds ownership context; this tests mutually inconsistent affirmative disclosure facts within carefully matched legal scope.
access_status: Public search/forms documented; field interpretation and cross-regime identity need manual review. No filing sampled.
legal_or_logical_status: Conditional source-specific predicate; governing document and case facts must be established before a legal assertion.
checks_actually_performed: Catalog fields, prior mechanisms and cited official documentation reviewed; no matching substantive records or positive finding tested.
checks_proposed_not_performed: Read the exact yes/no declaration and applicable rule before joining names; confirm the client is the same entity described in Exhibit A.
expectation_strength: cross-regime declaration consistency; thresholds and scope must be verified
